crew_workspace_art_how_allowed_from_your: Line of the onboarding animation after the user taps Allow on the phone. Decorative, the same words as the real approval.
crew_workspace_art_how_asleep: Tag next to the laptop chip of the onboarding animation once the computer goes to sleep; reads 'your computer, asleep'. Lowercase.

crew_workspace_art_how_done.description: Lowercase status of the demo crewmate in the onboarding animation once its work is finished.
crew_workspace_art_how_done.distinct: lowercase status chip of an animation, not the Done button

crew_workspace_art_how_name_needs_you: Title of the phone notification in the onboarding animation; {name} is the demo crewmate's name.
crew_workspace_art_how_needs_you: Lowercase status of the demo crewmate in the onboarding animation while it waits for approval.
crew_workspace_art_how_order: The order typed into the composer in the onboarding animation. An instruction written to the crewmate.
crew_workspace_art_how_pr_115_opened: Event line of the demo crewmate card in the onboarding animation. The pull request number is made up.
crew_workspace_art_how_say_ask: The demo crewmate asks permission to push, in the onboarding animation. 'main' is the branch name.
crew_workspace_art_how_say_morning: The demo crewmate's last chat message in the onboarding animation, the next morning. The numbers are made up.
crew_workspace_art_how_say_start: The demo crewmate's first chat reply in the onboarding animation. Friendly, first person.
crew_workspace_art_how_say_thanks: The demo crewmate's reply after the user allowed the push, in the onboarding animation.
crew_workspace_art_how_step_comments: Third step of the onboarding animation. Past tense; the number is made up.
crew_workspace_art_how_step_push: Last step of the onboarding animation, after the user allowed the push. Past tense.
crew_workspace_art_how_step_read: First step ticked off in the onboarding animation. Past tense; the numbers are made up.
crew_workspace_art_how_step_tests: Second step of the onboarding animation. Past tense; the numbers are made up.
crew_workspace_art_how_your_server: Chip of the onboarding animation: the machine the crewmate works on. Lowercase.
crew_workspace_attachment_incomplete: Error when an image attached to a task could not be fetched completely from the crew server; {name} is the file name.
crew_workspace_board_add_trigger: Line of a board card where the crewmate proposes an automation trigger for the user to add.
crew_workspace_board_clear_filters: Button of the empty board state: removes every filter.

crew_workspace_board_column_done.description: Title of the last board column: tasks that finished, failed or were cancelled.
crew_workspace_board_column_done.distinct: board column heading for finished tasks; common_action_done is a button

crew_workspace_board_column_task_count: Accessible name of the number badge in a board column header: how many tasks the column holds.
crew_workspace_board_column_tasks: Accessible name of one board column's list of tasks; {label} is the column's name (Queued, Working, Needs you, Done).
crew_workspace_board_connect_github: Line of a board card that needs a GitHub sign-in on the crew server to continue.
crew_workspace_board_crew_board: Accessible name of the board region (the columns of tasks).
crew_workspace_board_needs_input: Line of a board card: the crewmate asked something and waits for the answer.
crew_workspace_board_no_tasks_match_thes: Empty state of the board when the filters hide every task; the Clear filters button follows.
crew_workspace_board_queued: Title of the first board column and the line of a queued task: it waits for a free agent slot.
crew_workspace_board_queued_reason: Line of a queued task that waits for something this app does not know; {reason} is hostd's own text, shown as sent.
crew_workspace_board_queued_server_busy: Line of a queued task whose crew server has no free agent slot. Maps hostd's waiting_for value 'server busy'.
crew_workspace_board_toolbar_7_days: Button of the board toolbar: the done column shows the last 7 days.
crew_workspace_board_toolbar_done_range: Accessible name of the Today / 7 days switch of the board toolbar.
crew_workspace_board_toolbar_filter_by_c: Accessible name of the row of crewmate chips that filter the board.
crew_workspace_board_toolbar_search_task: Accessible name of the board's search field.
crew_workspace_board_toolbar_show_done: Checkbox of the board toolbar: show or hide the Done column.
crew_workspace_board_toolbar_source_all: Segment of the board's source filter: tasks from chats and automations.
crew_workspace_board_toolbar_source_chat: Segment of the board's source filter: tasks the user started from a chat.
crew_workspace_board_toolbar_source_filt: Accessible name of the All / Chats / Automations switch of the board toolbar.
crew_workspace_board_toolbar_today: Button of the board toolbar: the done column shows today's tasks only.
crew_workspace_board_wants_approval: Line of a board card: the crewmate is blocked on a tool approval.
crew_workspace_board_work_refused: Line of a board card whose work the guards refused (a UI task with no proof).
crew_workspace_browsers_cost: Hint under the capture browsers opt-in of the crew server setup: what they cost. {node} is the minimum Node major version.
crew_workspace_close_button_close_integr: Accessible name of the × button of the integrations screen.
crew_workspace_crewmate_editor_color: Heading and accessible name of the body color swatches in the crewmate editor.
crew_workspace_crewmate_editor_custom_co: Tooltip and accessible name of the custom color picker in the crewmate editor.
crew_workspace_crewmate_editor_customize: Title of the dialog where the user designs a crewmate's look.
crew_workspace_crewmate_editor_eyes: Heading and accessible name of the eye styles in the crewmate editor.
crew_workspace_crewmate_editor_face: Heading and accessible name of the eyewear options (eyepatch, glasses) in the crewmate editor.
crew_workspace_crewmate_editor_hat: Heading and accessible name of the hat options in the crewmate editor.
crew_workspace_crewmate_editor_outfit: Heading and accessible name of the clothing options in the crewmate editor.
crew_workspace_crewmate_editor_preview_s: Accessible name of the row that previews the crewmate idle, working, needing you or offline.
crew_workspace_crewmate_editor_randomize: Button of the crewmate editor: picks a random look.
crew_workspace_crewmate_editor_role_kits: Heading of the one-click presets (Captain, Reviewer...) in the crewmate editor.
crew_workspace_crewmate_editor_tool: Heading and accessible name of the tool options (compass, wrench) in the crewmate editor.
crew_workspace_crewmate_list_row_first_m: Item of a crewmate row's menu when it is the first mate (the favorite): choosing it removes the star. A star glyph precedes it.
crew_workspace_crewmate_list_row_make_fi: Item of a crewmate row's menu: makes this crewmate the first mate of its crew server, shown large at the top. A star glyph precedes it.
crew_workspace_crewmate_list_row_more_op: Accessible name of the … button of a crewmate row; {name} is the crewmate.
crew_workspace_crewmate_list_row_needs_y: Accessible name of the ! badge on a crewmate row that waits for the user.
crew_workspace_crewmate_list_row_profile: Item of a crewmate row's menu: opens that crewmate's profile.
crew_workspace_crewmate_list_row_unread_: Accessible name of the dot that marks unread messages on a crewmate row and on the first mate.
crew_workspace_demo_page_back_to_the_cre: Button of the crew demo page (a development page): leaves the editor.
crew_workspace_demo_page_build_a_crewmat: Button of the crew demo page (a development page): opens the crewmate editor. i18n-allow dnt:build
crew_workspace_demo_page_state: Accessible name of the state buttons of the crew demo page (a development page).
crew_workspace_empty_choose_a_crewmate_o: Hint of the workspace empty state, under 'No crew selected'.
crew_workspace_empty_no_crew_selected: Title of the workspace empty state when no crewmate is open.
crew_workspace_empty_recruit_a_crewmate: Button of the workspace empty state: creates a crewmate.
crew_workspace_github_accounts_disconnec: Button that removes a crew server's GitHub sign-in.
crew_workspace_github_accounts_no_crew_s: Empty state of the GitHub accounts card when no crew server exists.
crew_workspace_github_accounts_not_conne: Status of a crew server with no GitHub sign-in.
crew_workspace_github_accounts_title: Title of the card that lists GitHub sign-ins per crew server.
crew_workspace_github_device_flow_enter_: Start of the GitHub device sign-in instruction; the verification link follows it.
crew_workspace_github_device_flow_waitin: Line of the GitHub device sign-in while the app polls for the user's approval in the browser.
crew_workspace_github_sign_in_failed: Error toast when the GitHub device sign-in on a crew server ended with an error and the server gave no reason.
crew_workspace_hero_favorite_label: Accessible name of the large first mate button at the top of the sidebar; {name} is the crewmate.
crew_workspace_integration_detail_back_t: Accessible name of the back arrow of an integration's detail page.
crew_workspace_integration_detail_integr: Accessible name of the list of skills on an integration's detail page.
crew_workspace_integration_detail_skills: Title of the skills card on an integration's detail page.
crew_workspace_integration_detail_view_s: Link on an integration's detail page: opens its source code.
Accessible name of the View source link; {name} is the integration.
crew_workspace_model_picker_choose: Placeholder of the model picker once the gateway listed its models.
crew_workspace_model_picker_fill_first: Placeholder of the model picker before the gateway's URL and API key are filled.
crew_workspace_model_picker_loading_mode: Placeholder of the model picker while the gateway's model list loads.
crew_workspace_model_picker_no_match: Empty state of the model picker: the typed text can still be used as a model id.
crew_workspace_model_picker_search: Placeholder of the search field inside the model picker's list.
crew_workspace_model_picker_type_id: Placeholder of the model picker when the gateway listed no models.
crew_workspace_palette_crew_and_commands: Accessible name of the result list of the crew search.
crew_workspace_palette_crew_search: Title of the crew search dialog (read by screen readers; the dialog has no visible title).
crew_workspace_palette_keyboard_shortcut: Command of the crew search: opens the list of keyboard shortcuts.
crew_workspace_palette_no_results_for_qu: Empty state of the crew search; {query} is what the user typed.
crew_workspace_palette_search_crewmates_: Accessible name of the crew search field.
crew_workspace_pause_banner_paused: Banner over the workspace while the only crew server is paused.
crew_workspace_pause_banner_paused_serve: Banner over the workspace when one of several crew servers is paused; {server} is its name.
crew_workspace_pause_banner_resume: Button of the pause banner: resumes the crew server.
crew_workspace_pause_banner_resuming: Label of the pause banner's button while the crew server resumes.
crew_workspace_provider_connected_models: Result of testing a custom gateway: it answered and lists {count} models.
crew_workspace_sidebar_cant_reach: Message in the sidebar when a crew server did not answer; a Retry button follows. {server} is the server's name.
crew_workspace_sidebar_cant_reach_error: Same message with the reason; {error} is the error text of the connection, shown as received.
crew_workspace_sidebar_footer_add_a_crew: Button of the sidebar footer: starts adding a crew server (opens the Atlas Crew setup).
crew_workspace_sidebar_footer_crew_serve: Item of the footer menu and of the crew search: opens the crew server's settings. i18n-allow dnt:Crew
crew_workspace_sidebar_footer_help: Item of the footer menu and subtitle of the shortcuts command in the crew search: opens the Atlas Crew help.
crew_workspace_sidebar_footer_manage: Right side of the Integrations row of the footer menu when nothing is connected yet.
crew_workspace_sidebar_footer_open_integ: Accessible name of the Integrations row of the footer menu.
crew_workspace_sidebar_footer_pause_all: Item of the footer menu: pauses every crew server (cancels running tasks, holds the queues).
crew_workspace_sidebar_footer_paused: Small tag next to the user's name in the footer while a crew server is paused.
crew_workspace_sidebar_footer_resume_all: Item of the footer menu: resumes every paused crew server.
crew_workspace_sidebar_footer_user: Accessible name of the button that opens the footer menu (the user's avatar).
crew_workspace_sidebar_header_new_crewma: Accessible name of the + button of the sidebar and name of the New crewmate command of the crew search.
crew_workspace_sidebar_header_search: Accessible name of the magnifier button of the sidebar; {key} is the shortcut that opens the crew search, spelled for the platform.
crew_workspace_ssh_bad_port: Error of the crew server address field: the part after the colon is not a TCP port.
crew_workspace_ssh_close_ipv6: Error of the crew server address field: an IPv6 address opened with [ and never closed.
crew_workspace_ssh_enter_address: Error of the crew server address field when it is empty.
crew_workspace_ssh_include_host: Error of the crew server address field when it has no host.
crew_workspace_ssh_include_user: Error of the crew server address field when it has no user@ part.
crew_workspace_ssh_ipv6_port: Error of the crew server address field: text after the closing bracket of an IPv6 address that is not :port.
crew_workspace_status_idle: State of a crewmate that is not doing anything; a button of the crewmate editor's preview row.
crew_workspace_status_offline: State of a crewmate whose crew server cannot be reached; a button of the crewmate editor's preview row.
crew_workspace_status_working: Lowercase preview line of a crewmate row in the sidebar while it works (shimmering). The ellipsis means the work is not over.
crew_workspace_task_work_earlier: Line above the visible steps of the running section: how many earlier steps are hidden.
crew_workspace_task_work_steps: Count on a folded section of a task's work: how many steps it holds.
crew_workspace_task_work_untitled: Heading of a finished section of a task's work when the crewmate set no title.
crew_workspace_usage_meter_resets: Small line of the usage meter: when the engine's usage limit resets; {time} is a local clock time.
crew_workspace_usage_sparkline_label: Accessible name of the 14-day token usage chart.
crew_workspace_usage_sparkline_tokens: Tooltip of one bar of the 14-day usage chart: the token count of that day, formatted for the locale.
crew_workspace_view_bar_board: Segment and hint of the crew view switcher: the board of tasks. 'Board' stays English, as in the docs.
crew_workspace_view_bar_board_view: Accessible name of the Board segment of the view switcher.
crew_workspace_view_bar_chat: Segment of the crew view switcher: the chat with a crewmate.
crew_workspace_view_bar_chat_view: Accessible name of the Chat segment of the view switcher.
crew_workspace_view_bar_crew_view_switch: Accessible name of the Chat / Board switcher (a toolbar).
